IncidentDef.label: ancient survey annex discovered
IncidentDef.letterText: Long-range scans have found a fractured precursor survey annex. Its outer architecture and dead laboratory hardware match known Ancient sites, and no active faction signature is present. A central survey matrix remains unusually intact among the ruins. By this stage, intact precursor systems deserve caution: inspect the site, heed any warning generated near the matrix, and withdraw or destroy it if the signal changes before committing to the inner ruin.
